• Raipur–Dhanbad Economic Corridor | Urga–Pathalgaon Section Latest Ground Update*
Welcome back to another infrastructure update!
In this video, we take you to the Urga–Pathalgaon Section of the Raipur–Dhanbad Economic Corridor in Chhattisgarh to explore the latest construction progress on the ground.
From Pathalgaon to the challenging hill-cutting stretches, this video covers highway construction, entry & exit points, road crossings, VOP structures, toll plaza progress, & the remaining safety-related works.
